direction.content_form: A continuous drawn courtyard evening: eating and listening share a near-to-far diagonal, rather than separate activity pictures.
direction.whole_expression_style: Crisp digital ink narrative with selective luminous washes. A cropped shared spring-greens soup at near right, seated adult neighbors across the middle, and an informal flutist farther left create depth through occlusion and changing scale.
direction.reference_transfer: vi-protomen: let distance, cropped foreground and diminishing figures organize attention; replace its opposing flank structure with one asymmetric diagonal. vi-grandfather: vary contour density to join gathering and open reading pockets, without portraits or archival surface.

layout.large_relationship: The near-right rim and listeners sweep toward the far-left musician; title occupies the inner bend, while two practical clusters sit at different depths along that sweep. No rendered wall, floor or sky is manufactured as an information panel.
layout.alignment: Stable horizontal text inside unequal contour-defined pockets; left title/date cluster and right arrival cluster share no common full-width footer.
layout.visible_reading_route: Near meal/listeners → title in the bend → date and hours just above it → venue and entry at upper right → purchase/participation below the venue → cup and lingering invitation beside the near gathering.

direction.typography: A legible broad-pen Korean title is the conversational focal point; compact English is a companion. Practical copy uses a clear medium humanist sans with tabular numerals; its quieter hierarchy follows the pictorial depth.
direction.image: One coherent oblique viewpoint, with anonymous adults eating while facing the woodwind player. New soup, dishes, clothing and gestures; crop the near serving rim at right/bottom without clipping copy. Retain shared sightlines and continuous seating so music belongs to the meal.
direction.material: Clean digital line and wash, with intentional changes in line density; no distressed paper, ink damage, tape or claims of handmade production.
direction.color: Deep blue-green contours, amber local light and fresh green food accents. Warm pale letters on dark contour pockets; dark letters on clear light pockets. Keep wash and detailed hatching away from practical text, and preserve the dash/colon at 720.
direction.emotion: An intimate, unhurried adult evening with room to listen and linger; no heroic performer staging.
direction.closest_direction_contrast: Against M3, this is one oblique depth corridor with a conversational title; M3 is a plan-view enclosing assembly with a central typographic hub.
